title: Completed SOURCE SELECTION CRITERIA Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed SOURCE SELECTION CRITERIA artifact data payloads (PMO-04.09.03).

technical_capability_and_understanding_w.description: Scoring weight and criteria assessing technical approach, compliance with SOW, and architecture.

vendor_experience_and_past_performance_w.description: Scoring weight and criteria evaluating track record, references, and relevant past project delivery.

financial_commercial_pricing_weight.description: Scoring weight and evaluation model for pricing, total cost of ownership (TCO), and rate competitiveness.

management_approach_and_compliance_weigh.description: Scoring weight evaluating project management methodology, staffing qualifications, and contractual compliance.

vendor_candidate_name_and_proposal_ident.description: Identification of bidding vendor, proposal reference number, and submission date.

technical_and_commercial_score_breakdown.description: Individual numerical scores assigned across technical, commercial, and past performance criteria.

total_weighted_score.description: Consolidated total weighted evaluation score out of 100 points for each candidate.

comparative_analysis_and_value_justifica.description: Narrative justifying why the winning proposal offers superior value, quality, or pricing.

contract_award_recommendation_and_sign_o.description: Formal evaluation committee recommendation identifying preferred vendor for contract execution.
